title: Safety & Efficacy of Atorvastatin for Prophylaxis of Acute Graft Versus Host Disease in Patients With Hematological Malignancies HLA- Donor Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation

sections.abstract:
Phase II trial evaluating the safety \& efficacy of Atorvastatin for prophylaxis of Acute Graft Versus Host Disease (GVHD) in patients with hematological malignances undergoing human leukocyte antigen (HLA)-Matched Related Donor Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplant (HSCT).

Posted outcomes: Percentage of Participants With Grades II to IV aGVHD at Day +100 of Atorvastatin Administration. timeframe=Up through day 100 following transplant. Patients=30
